# SlowBlues

> SlowBlues is an independent editorial blues archive — 330+ artist profiles, reviews, history, festivals, radio and gear, with a Nordic perspective on the Delta, Chicago and global blues tradition.

SlowBlues is a multilingual (Norwegian, English, German, Swedish) reference site for blues music. It documents pioneers, modern voices, instruments, festivals, radio stations and culture surrounding the blues. Content is editorial, non-commercial and updated continuously.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, latest editorial highlights and featured artists.
- [Artists](/artists): Searchable archive of 330+ blues artist profiles.
- [Blog](/blog): Reviews, interviews, deep dives, tour reports.
- [History](/history): Timeline of the blues from field hollers to today.
- [Styles](/styles): Delta vs Chicago vs Texas vs British blues styles.
- [Festivals](/festivals): Major blues festivals in Norway, Europe and the US.
- [Radio](/radio): Blues radio stations and weekly shows.
- [Gear](/learn/gear): Guitars, amps, harmonicas and microphones that shaped the sound.
- [Instruments](/instruments): The instruments of the blues.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Editorial photography.
- [World Map](/worldmap): Blues places — cradles, clubs, festivals, graves, studios.
- [Watch](/watch) and [Listen](/listen): Curated video and audio.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side comparison of blues styles.
- [About](/about): About SlowBlues and the editorial mission.
- [Support](/support): Ways to support the archive.
- [Contact](/contact): Editorial contact.
